The helper makes touch events. The slider has no touch listener: a touch drag gives pointer events, and `touch-action: none` on the control keeps them. `test/pointer.ts` drags a real touch in Chromium.

`Slider.pointer.test.ts` tests the press and the drag with pointer events and capture: the nearest thumb, the thumbs at `max`, the least distance, a value area of 0, the end of a press, a second pointer, and a disabled or removed control. The touch cases do not apply: the slider has no touch listener, and `touch-action: none` keeps a touch drag. Each move starts from the values that the slider shows. When the parent adds or removes a value during a press, the end of the press commits only a later change, and the next press works.

`Slider.pointer.test.ts` tests the indicator of `thumbAlignment="edge"`: each end is at the centre of its thumb. `Slider.test.ts` tests the inline style and the state attributes. The cases of `--start-position`, `--relative-size` and `visibility` do not apply: no part sets them.

`Slider.Label` is a native `<label>` for the input of the first thumb. A click gives that input the focus and the focus ring in each browser. `Slider.test.ts` tests its `for`, its id, a click, and the `aria-labelledby` of the root and of each input. The shadow root cases do not apply: `for` is the rule of the platform.

`Slider.test.ts` tests the value, the grid, the events, the keys, the names, the text and the disabled state. `Slider.pointer.test.ts` tests the press, and the focus ring after a press and after a key. `Slider.field.test.ts` tests the form, the reset, the field and the fieldset. `Slider.hydration.test.ts` tests the server HTML. These cases do not apply: the default `aria-valuetext` of a range, `aria-valuenow` (the native value is the value), `preventBaseUIHandler`, the reason `none` of a reset and the touch listeners.

`Slider.test.ts` tests where the attributes of a thumb go, its input, the `element` slot with `inputProps` and `inputRef`, `getAriaValueText`, the active thumb and its `z-index`. A `preventDefault()` in a keydown listener of the developer keeps the value, as on a native range input. `Slider.pointer.test.ts` tests the blur and the focus that show the focus ring at a key after a press: the field and the listeners of the page do not get them. The cases of `getAriaLabel` and `data-index` do not apply: give each thumb an `aria-label` and a class. The cases of the measured `edge` thumb do not apply: CSS places it. The `aria-valuetext` of a `format` has the locale of `Slider.Value`, also before the hydration (VUE-170).
`Slider.test.ts` tests the element and the state attributes of each part.

`Slider.test.ts` tests the text of `Slider.Value`, its `for`, `format`, `locale`, and the default slot and the `element` slot with `values` and `formattedValues`. With no `locale`, the text has the locale of the nearest `LocaleProvider`, else `en-US`, on the server and in the browser, so it does not change after the hydration (VUE-170). `LocaleProvider.test.ts` hydrates `Slider.Value` with no message.

`values.test.ts` tests the grid, the limits of a key and the rules `none`, `push` and `swap`, with the rows of this file that state a result for values, a thumb and a target. The cases of `initialValues` and of live values do not apply: the functions have no such parameters, and each move starts from the values that the slider shows.
